meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 初始化 OneCLI 凭证库并迁移环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just installed OneCLI or need to migrate .env credentials to the vault

howto.what: Claude会安装OneCLI并配置Agent Vault网关,把.env里的凭据迁入保险库,再从.env删除明文密钥,最后重新构建并重启服务,验证网关日志。
howto.when: 在/update-nanoclaw引入OneCLI破坏性变更后,或首次设置OneCLI时触发;若检测到已配置,会先询问保留现状还是重配。

say.text: 重新配置 OneCLI,让网关统一注入密钥。
say.note: 走重配流程,重新注册 Anthropic 凭据。

say.text: 把 OPENAI_API_KEY 也迁到 OneCLI 保险库。
say.note: 迁移后原变量从 .env 移除,由网关注入。

howto.what_en: Installs OneCLI, configures the Agent Vault gateway, migrates .env credentials into the vault, removes raw keys from .env, rebuilds, restarts the service, and verifies gateway logs.
howto.when_en: Triggers after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or on first-time OneCLI setup; if OneCLI is already configured, it asks whether to keep or reconfigure.

say_en.text: Run /init-onecli and migrate the Anthropic key from .env to the vault.
say_en.note: Installs OneCLI and migrates the credentials.

say_en.text: Reconfigure OneCLI so the gateway injects secrets centrally.
Move OPENAI_API_KEY into the OneCLI vault too.
say_en.note: The variable is removed from .env after migration.
